Fleming''' (born July 10, 2004) is an American [[basketball]] player who plays for the [[Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball|Saint Joseph's Hawks]] of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. ==Early life and high school== Fleming grew up in [[Camden, New Jersey]] and attended [[Camden High School (New Jersey)|Camden High School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/st-joes/camden-highs-rasheer-fleming-seeks-smooth-transition-hawk-hill-20211230.html|title=Camden High's Rasheer Fleming seeks smooth transition to Hawk Hill|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=December 30, 2021|access-date=October 18, 2024}} Fleming committed to play [[college basketball]] at [[Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball|Saint Joseph's]] over offers from [[Albany Great Danes men's basketball|Albany]], [[Siena Saints men's basketball|Siena]], and [[Towson Tigers men's basketball|Towson]].{{cite web|url=https://www.courierpostonline.com/story/sports/high-school/boys-basketball/2021/11/15/camden-rasheer-fleming-commits-play-basketball-st-josephs/8620872002/|title=Camden's Rasheer Fleming commits to play basketball at St. Joseph's|work=[[Courier-Post]]|date=November 15, 2021|access-date=October 18, 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.courierpostonline.com/story/sports/high-school/boys-basketball/2021/11/15/camden-rasheer-fleming-commits-play-basketball-st-josephs/8620872002/|title=Camden senior Rasheer Fleming signs letter of intent to play basketball at St. Joseph's|first=Josh|last=Friedman|work=[[Courier-Post]]|date=November 15, 2021|access-date=December 5, 2024}} ==College career== Fleming averaged 5.8 points and 5.0 rebounds per game during his freshman season with the [[Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball|Saint Joseph's Hawks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/st-joes/rasheer-fleming-saint-josephs-basketball-mens-a10-tournament-20240315.html|title=St. Joe’s sophomore forward Rasheer Fleming’s rise is fueling a trip to the A-10 semifinal|first=Lochlahn|last=March|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=March 15, 2024|access-date=October 18, 2024}} He became the Hawks' starting power forward midway through his freshman year.{{cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/big-5-classic-sju-temple-championship-20231202.html|title=Big 5 Classic: The path to an ‘appointed and anointed time’ for St. Joe’s featured a big night from Rasheer Fleming|work=[[The Philadelphia Inquirer]]|date=December 2, 2023|access-date=October 29, 2024}} Fleming finished his sophomore season averaging 10.7 points per game.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/nba-draft-saint-joseph-rasheer-fleming-versatility-power-five|title=NBA Draft: Saint Joseph's Rasheer Fleming Has Shown Impressive Versatility Against Three Power Five Opponents|first=Jace|last=Derryberry|website=[[SI.com]]|date=November 24, 2024|access-date=December 5, 2024}} During his junior season, he scored 19 points in a win over rival Villanova.{{cite web|url=https://www.delcotimes.com/2024/11/12/rasheer-fleming-scores-19-points-to-lead-saint-josephs-past-villanova/|title=Rasheer Fleming scores 19 points to lead Saint Joseph’s past
